summary: Malibu Boats (MBI) filed an 8-K presenting unaudited pro forma condensed combined financials for FY2026 to reflect its completed acquisition of Saxdor Yachts Oy, a Finnish yacht maker, under a Stock Purchase Agreement closed March 2, 2026. The filing updates previously disclosed pro forma information as required for Form S-3, noting the fiscal-year statement does not project future results. No deal terms, price, premium, or advisors are disclosed. The report is informational only, with no shareholder vote or regulatory clock. What to watch: any subsequent earnings impact from Saxdor integration and potential accretion or dilution disclosures in future filings. Risk-arb angle: deal is closed, so no arbitrage opportunity remains.
